XGBoost_Regressor.description: Gradient boosted decision tree ensemble minimizing weighted absolute error loss using second-order Taylor expansion and exact tree split pruning.

learning_rate.justification: Moderate shrinkage prevents gradient oscillations across volatile holiday spikes while ensuring steady monotonic convergence.

n_estimators.justification: Higher capacity combined with smaller learning rate captures subtle department-specific seasonal curves; monitored with early stopping.

max_depth.justification: Depth 10 accommodates multi-way non-linear interactions between Store Type, Department ID, and specific holiday ISO weeks.

min_child_weight.justification: Acts as an essential variance stabilizer; forces leaves to contain at least 12 weighted samples, preventing overfitting on rare returns or outlier weeks.

subsample.justification: Row subsampling introduces stochastic bagging diversity, reducing tree correlation and mitigating high variance.

colsample_bytree.justification: Feature subsampling prevents dominant features (like store size or historical department median) from monopolizing every split.

reg_alpha.justification: L1 leaf regularization induces sparsity in leaf weight updates, eliminating noisy splits from zero-markdown periods.

reg_lambda.justification: L2 regularization smooths leaf outputs, penalizing extreme forecast spikes during regular non-promotional periods.

early_stopping_patience.justification: Safely halts training when validation WMAE fails to improve for 40 consecutive boosting rounds.

loss_objective.justification: Directly minimizes MAE, which under sample weights (5x on holidays, 1x regular) directly targets the competition WMAE.

LightGBM_Regressor.description: Fast leaf-wise tree growth with gradient-based histogram binning and native categorical handling.

learning_rate.justification: Balances convergence speed with granular seasonal partitioning.

n_estimators.justification: Optimal stopping reached at 797 iterations during validation benchmarking.

num_leaves.justification: Allows deep asymmetry in holiday-sensitive tree branches without building unnecessary leaves elsewhere.

subsample.justification: Mitigates variance across contiguous weekly observations.

reg_lambda.justification: L2 regularization prevents runaway predictions on small volume departments.

loss_objective.justification: L1 objective aligns strictly with WMAE.

CatBoost_Regressor.model_family: Oblivious Boosted Trees with Ordered Target Statistics
CatBoost_Regressor.description: Symmetric decision trees with target statistics to prevent categorical target leakage.

learning_rate.justification: Standard boosting rate for oblivious trees.

depth.justification: Oblivious tree depth creates symmetric 2^7 = 128 table lookups per tree.

Random_Forest_Regressor.model_family: Bagged Ensemble of De-correlated Decision Trees
Random_Forest_Regressor.description: Parallel bagging ensemble providing high robustness to target outliers and negative sales noise.

n_estimators.justification: 100 trees provide reliable variance reduction with manageable training wall time (~51s).

max_depth.justification: Explicit depth cap prevents full-depth leaf memorization on individual store-dept transactions.

min_samples_leaf.justification: Ensures terminal nodes average over multiple weekly observations.

max_features.justification: Subsampling features per split reduces tree correlation.

Ridge_Regression.description: Closed-form L2 regularized linear model establishing the benchmark performance floor and diagnosing non-linear bias.

alpha.justification: Moderate shrinkage accounts for collinearity among store size, store type, and macroeconomic metrics.

standardization.justification: Required prior to penalization so scale differences (Store Size ~10^5 vs Fuel Price ~10^0) do not distort coefficient shrinkage.
